$comment: Behavioral configuration shared by agent/create_agent.py and the Foundry UI guide. Copy to agent/config.json to customize. Environment-specific values (endpoints, model deployment, tools URL) belong in .env, never here.
description: Contoso Air Customer Care: helps travelers resolve flight disruptions using reservation, flight-status and flight-search tools grounded in Contoso Air policy.

tools.name: contoso_air_operations
tools.description: Contoso Air Operations API (read-only facts): the signed-in customer's reservations, authoritative flight status, and alternative flights with seat availability by cabin. Returns data only; it does not recommend, rebook, or apply policy.

starterPrompts: My flight was cancelled. What are my options?
Can you check my upcoming trip?
What benefits do I receive during a cancellation?
Can my family stay together if we're rebooked?
heroPrompt: My flight tomorrow was cancelled. I'm traveling with my wife and two children. Can you help me figure out what to do?
